findings.reason: A71 establishes intraperitoneal dosing, plasma HPLC-UV, repeat dosing, day-2 sampling and non-neutropenic disseminated A. flavus infection. Total versus unbound concentration basis, dose formulation basis, co-medication and grapefruit-juice status are NOT_FOUND. The sampling-time origin is not explicitly defined beyond predose and treatment day.
findings.needed_material: Resolve consequential missing basis and compatibility metadata before grouping, conversion or transfer; retain unknown intervention statuses as unknown.

findings.reason: Four dose groups and a seven-day regimen are reported, with PK sampled on treatment day 2. This item contains no concentration-time curves or PK comparisons across treatment days. Dose dependence, time-dependent clearance and their estimability remain unresolved; parameter differences do not establish a mechanism.
findings.needed_material: Retain dose-specific day-2 identities and obtain any authorized matching curves, prior-dose histories and across-day inputs needed by the downstream modeling objective. Leave numerical sufficiency to the animal PK module.

findings.reason: MI006 remains OPEN, status DEFERRED, needed_at pk, originating in main:/missing_information/items/5. For DR11, A71 reports 90 infected mice and 3 per time, but provides no animal identifiers, verified serial or destructive sampling structure, individual records, variability definitions or parameter uncertainty. Those counts do not establish individual PK variability.
findings.needed_material: Assess authorized individual records and sampling structure at pk. Distinguish interindividual variability from parameter uncertainty and explicitly report unsupported variability without inventing it; preserve independent group-level candidate work.

findings.reason: MI004 remains OPEN, status CONFLICT, needed_at pk, originating in main:/missing_information/items/3. A72 reports an adopted 29.87% unbound fraction from S03, whereas SC023 preserves mouse 29.97% unbound in plasma alongside mouse 78% bound in serum, mouse 67% in the secondary table and rat 64-66%. The 29.87% versus 29.97% discrepancy and the existing binding conflict remain unresolved; this study did not measure unbound fraction.
findings.needed_material: Review the discrepancy and source applicability before dependent acceptance. At pk, record analysis-specific applicability decisions under DR12, preserve every reported value and basis, never average the sources, and carry fu as a sensitivity parameter under R06 and SC024.

findings.reason: A72 supplies an adopted percentage-scale unbound fraction, not a binding measurement or direct unbound concentration. The measured species and matrix behind that adopted value, binding method, concentration range, temperature, pH and recovery information are NOT_FOUND in this item. The study's plasma PK matrix does not establish the binding measurement matrix.
findings.needed_material: Before binding-dependent use, assess authorized S03 binding evidence and its applicability to this study. Preserve the assumed-input status and missing conditions; do not convert concentrations or replace missing fu here.

findings.needed_material: Reuse the reviewed parameter inventory; determine whether the reported weight range suffices for the explicitly considered approach and obtain additional study-linked size or calibration inputs only where required.
